title: Rate Cards
description: Structured pricing entries that providers can publish so requestors see costs before contacting them.
content:
# Rate Cards

Rate cards give service providers a way to publish structured pricing on their provider profile. Each card describes a specific service with a label, pricing model (standard, free, or negotiable), and optional notes.

## Pricing Models

- **Standard**: A numeric rate with a unit (per hour, per session, per trip, or flat rate).
- **Free**: The provider offers this service at no charge.
- **Negotiable**: Price is discussed directly between provider and requestor.

## Where Rate Cards Appear

Rate cards are visible on:
- The provider's detail page (`/providers/:id`) — accessible to unauthenticated users.
- The collective detail page — under the Member Pricing section.
- The request filing form — when requestors browse providers to pre-select.

## Provider Pre-Selection

When filing a typed request (ride, service, tutor, etc.), requestors can browse providers with matching rate cards and pre-select one. The pre-selected provider receives an in-app notification with a deep link to the request, and can accept by proposing to help.

## Soft-Delete

Rate cards are never hard-deleted. Deactivating a card sets `is_active = false` — the card remains in the database for historical reference but stops appearing publicly.
